title: 第1007章 再次上门第1006章 四者合一
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
同一时间。
邱家、林家、叶家，三大世家也在做着同样的准备。
想要登门看一看，这个被景无心收为徒弟的方正到底如何？
也正好先提前认识一下。
不久之后。
四道身影便出现在道观所在的山下。
刚一见面，邱不语、林守拙、跟皇甫嵩三人的目光就看向叶玄章。
虽然都没有说话，但眼中的意思不言而喻。
对此，叶玄章直接选择了无视，默默朝着山上走去。
“哼！”
皇甫嵩三人心中冷哼一声，一同踏上前往道观的路途。
很快，四道并肩而行的身影就出现在道观门口。
不等他们开口，道观大门就自行打开，景无心的声音也从院内传了出来。
“进来吧。”
叶玄章率先踏入道观之内，皇甫嵩等人紧随其后。
景无心依旧一个人独自坐在院中的石桌旁，跟叶玄章上次来时一样。
“景前辈。”
叶玄章四人站在景无心面前，恭敬的行了一礼。
景无心点了点头。
“嗯，给晚辈的见面礼准备好了？”

闻言，叶玄章四人立即大手一挥。
虚空中顿时浮现出诸多天材地宝跟丹药，其中最引人注意的，还是四件没有半点灵性的天兵。
这种天兵虽然威力上不及拥有灵性的天兵。
但威力也远超一般地兵。
适合给天骄使用，让天骄一路孕育灵性。
等天骄晋升天人之后，这件兵器也差不多拥有灵性，成为完整的天兵。
到时天兵也自然认主。
在其手中也能发挥出更大的威力。
景无心看了一眼四件天兵，长枪、刀、剑、还有棍。
算是比较常见的天兵类型。
然后景无心随意的挥了挥手，这些悬浮在空中的天材地宝、丹药、还有天兵，通通消失不见。
content_en:
at the same time.
The Qiu family, Lin family, and Ye family, the three major aristocratic families, are also making the same preparations.
I want to come and see how Fang Zheng, who was accepted as his disciple by Jing Wuxin, is doing?
It’s also a good time to get to know each other in advance.
Soon after.
Four figures appeared at the foot of the mountain where the Taoist temple was located.
As soon as they met, Qiu Buyu, Lin Shouzhuo, and Huangfu Song looked at Ye Xuanzhang.
Although neither of them spoke, the meaning in their eyes was self-evident.
Ye Xuanzhang simply chose to ignore this and walked silently towards the mountain.
"Hmph!"
Huangfusong and the other two snorted coldly in their hearts, and set off on the road to the Taoist temple together.
Soon, four figures walking side by side appeared at the entrance of the Taoist temple.
Before they could speak, the Taoist temple door opened on its own, and Jing Wuxin's voice came from the courtyard.
"Come in."
Ye Xuanzhang took the lead to step into the Taoist temple, followed closely by Huangfusong and others.
Jing Wuxin was still sitting alone at the stone table in the courtyard, just like when Ye Xuanzhang came last time.
"Senior Jing."
Ye Xuanzhang and the others stood in front of Jing Wuxin and bowed respectfully.
Jing Wuxin nodded.
"Well, are you ready for the meeting gift for the juniors?"
Hearing this, Ye Xuanzhang and the others immediately waved their hands.
Many heavenly materials, earthly treasures and elixirs suddenly appeared in the void, the most eye-catching of which were four heavenly weapons without any spirituality.
Although this kind of heavenly weapon is not as powerful as the spiritual heavenly weapon.
But its power far exceeds that of ordinary soldiers.
It is suitable for Tianjiao to use, so that Tianjiao can cultivate spirituality along the way.
After the genius is promoted to heaven, this weapon will almost have spirituality and become a complete heavenly weapon.
At that time, the heavenly soldiers will naturally recognize the master.
It can also exert greater power in its hands.
Jing Wuxin glanced at the four heavenly weapons, a spear, a knife, a sword, and a stick.
It is a relatively common type of heavenly soldier.
Then Jing Wuxin waved his hand casually, and all the heavenly materials, earthly treasures, elixirs, and heavenly weapons suspended in the air disappeared.
